status: Original synthetic classroom exercises; not actual market prices, yields, wage rates or farm records
scope: Three separate exercises on the same fictional practice farm. Do not combine their balances or carry forward F1/F2 values.

allocation.period: Practice cycle A; all listed cash costs paid in this cycle

breakEven.unit: one 1 kg pack prepared and sold
assumptions: Every pack prepared is sold in this bounded model
Constant price and included variable cost per pack
Included fixed costs do not change within the stated capacity
No closing stock, discount, refund, credit loss or tax calculation
Result is an included-cost model surplus, not complete accounting profit

buyers.period: Separate practice decision C; choose one offer for the same produce
assumptions: Both buyers accept the same 20 kg quality and weight
No sales are counted until agreed and made
Listed delivery and packaging costs are incremental and paid by the grower
Family hours are additional selling work, valued separately from cash
Quotes are invented practice inputs; payment reliability is not guaranteed
